extracted.name: Amish Peanut Butter
extracted.description: This is a tasty peanut butter spread, sometimes known as 'church spread' that is common among the Amish and Mennonite communities. Great on bread, bananas, ice cream or just by the spoonful!
instruction_lines: Stir corn syrup, peanut butter, and marshmallow cream together in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Store in an air-tight container.
